name: upper-body-band-resisted-dead-bug
instructions:
1. Attach a band to a rack and set up in a supine position with your legs in a 90/90 position (90 degree bend at the hips and knees) and your arms reaching towards the ceiling.
2. While keeping the arms straight, pull the band down to activate the lats.
3. Extend one leg as you exhale.
4. Return back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
5. Repeat for the desired number of total repetitions.
